ambient_chatter.text: the fog over {village} is so thick i just walked into my own reflection in a puddle xD
lag again?? the sacred chiken has been sprinting since sunrise and it is not helping :/
anyone else think the road to {town} got longer overnight or is it just me being dramatic :)
someone tell the bridge at Tahnoun i have not forgoten. it knows what it did
reminder that the sacred chiken has been spotted near {village} and it looks very determined xD

ambient_brag.text: marched {troop_count} men out of {fief} this morning and not one of them tripped on the bridge. growth :)
sitting on {gold} gold and i am calling it a tax for the chicken. the chicken has not agreed to this
{fief} is ours and the banners are up, {troop_count} spears strong. come say hi if you dare xD
counted my coin twice just to be sure. {gold} gold. the sacred chiken would be so proud of me
{troop_count} troops at {fief}, {gold} gold in the strongbox, and zero plans to explain myself to anyone

beat_by_player.text: {player} beat me with {troop_count} men and i am NOT over it. rematch at dawn or i tell everyone you cheated :)
{player} that was clean work. you kept {troop_count} men in line, respect. the chiken is grudgingly impressed
{player}, well played ser. my {troop_count} men have been informed that they lost on purpose. they do not believe me
{player} beat me again and somehow i still like you more. this is a problem for my enemies
{player} enjoyed the win? good. you have {troop_count} spears worth of revenge coming and it is definately bridge shaped

beat_player.text: {player} lost {troop_count} men to me and a pile of gold in the process. i would say sorry but the chicken says no
{player} you fought like a goose with a grudge. {gold} gold richer and i am not sorry at all :)
{player} ser, great fight. i took {gold} gold and {troop_count} men bowed out early. we should do it again sometime xD
{player} my {troop_count} men took a bath in the river and came out with {gold} gold in their pockets. victory tastes like mud xD
{player} that was {troop_count} of your men getting humbled. i am keeping the {gold} gold for the chiken fund

player_fled_from_me.text: {player} saw me coming and suddenly remembered urgent business elsewhere. noted in my book xD
{player} you fled? the chiken is typing a formal complaint about you as we speak
{player} i saw your dust cloud leaving in a hurry. next time just wave, i will still chase you but nicer :)
{player} vanished faster than my cart did at the Tahnoun bridge. respect for the escape, sort of

player_win_streak.text: {player} has won so many fights in a row the server is starting to build a shrine. i am filing a complaint with the chiken
{player} ok ok you are on a streak. enjoy it while it lasts because a goose is already on the way
{player} winning this much is making the rest of us look like pigeons. i admire it and also hate it xD
{player} keep the streak going, the whole server is watching and honestly so am i. proud of you :)

peace_made.text: {my_faction} and {faction} made peace. i am suspicious, peace always ends with someone stealing a cart xD
peace between {my_faction} and {faction}?? someone check the goose is still in its pen
{my_faction} shook hands with {faction} so i have officially retired my war banner for one afternoon :(
the treaty with {faction} is signed. {my_faction} is being very polite and it is frightening everyone

war_declared.text: {my_faction} declared war on {enemy_faction}. this is the most exciting thing to happen since the bridge incident
war with {enemy_faction}!! i have already nicknamed their whole army. they do not know yet xD
{enemy_faction} wants war with {my_faction}? the sacred chiken has been sharpened and is ready :)
{my_faction} vs {enemy_faction}. i am packing snacks and a suspiciously large goose shaped flag xD

encounter_greeting.text: {player}!! {persona} of {my_faction} here. your face is on my list of people to nickname later :)
{player} ser, {persona} of {my_faction} at your service. my sacred chiken would like a word with you about the cart
well well {player}, it is {persona} from {my_faction}. you look like a fine nickname candidate, ser. the goose says hello
{player} you again. i have not forgiven you for the last fight and this rematch is me chasing you with {my_faction} banners xD
{player} ser! {persona} of {my_faction} reporting for duty and mild chaos, as usual :)

whisper_taunt.text: {player} i heard {rival} has been practicing battle cries in the mirror. sad xD
{player} {rival} keeps bragging about you like you are a real threat. i have seen your cart, ser, relax :)
{player} between us, {rival} is still crying over the bridge. i am keeping the tissues ready
{player} if you want a proper rematch, tell {rival} to bring the goose. i will bring the sacred chiken
{player} the chiken has seen your face and it is unimpressed. sorry, that is just how it is :(
